scope: Audit only; no gameplay rules or numeric parameters changed

methodology.resources: Unmodified createPlayableGame; no treasury, army, population or disaster injection. Disaster seed and fixed createdAt are reproducibility parameters.
methodology.world: Full foreign strategy enabled, actual defense and relocation if required. All court actions charge energy, happiness and health, including outgoing battle result.
methodology.actions: Public production commands, actual prices and battle simulation using AI tactical actions. Three paid-free garden visits and sleep each turn maintain emperor wellbeing; no direct stat refill.
methodology.save: Validate and reload every 36 turns. 180 turns per scenario. All rows retained, not only final outcomes.
